nodes.name: Schedule: weekly Monday 08:00
nodes.notes: Monday 08:00, after the 06:00 sync, for last week (Monday to Sunday). Workflow settings > Timezone: FF's time zone.

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Run the weekly report from the dashboard. Answers 202 at once; the report carries on. No Slack note unless the body has slack: true.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Set SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SLACK_CHANNEL and DASHBOARD_URL after import.

nodes.name: Auth: read token
nodes.notes: Uses .first() on Webhook - singleton upstream node, so no paired-item ambiguity.

nodes.name: Auth: verify token
nodes.notes: Auth check block 2/4. Supabase Auth validates the JWT (signature, expiry). neverError + fullResponse so a 401 is data for 'Auth: check role', not a crash.

nodes.name: Auth: load profile
nodes.notes: Auth check block 3/4. Reads profiles with the service role. If the token was invalid it asks for the all-zero id, which matches nothing, and 'Auth: check role' has already got the 401 from the previous node.

nodes.name: Auth: check role
nodes.notes: Every downstream node reads the caller from $('Auth: check role').first().json.user - never from the request body. client_viewer workflows must also check user.client_id against the requested resource.

nodes.name: Respond: denied
nodes.notes: Same deny node in every webhook workflow. Returns 401/403/500 with a plain message; never echoes the token or profile.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'started', message: 'Weekly report started for the week of ' + $('Config').first().json.week_start + '. It appears on the client page when it finishes.' }) }}

nodes.name: Loop over clients
nodes.notes: One client per pass, so $('Loop over clients').first() is always the current client. One client failing does not stop the others.

nodes.name: GHL: location token
nodes.notes: Agency key (FF GHL) -> a short-lived token for this client's sub-account. Needs GHL_COMPANY_ID in Config and the oauth scopes on the agency key.

nodes.name: GHL: count Google Ads leads

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ locationId: $('Loop over clients').first().json.ghl_location_id, page: 1, pageLimit: 1, filters: [{ field: 'tags', operator: 'contains', value: [$('Config').first().json.GHL_GOOGLE_ADS_TAG] }, { field: 'dateAdded', operator: 'range', value: { gte: $('Loop over clients').first().json.week_start + 'T00:00:00.000Z', lte: $('Loop over clients').first().json.week_end + 'T23:59:59.999Z' } }] }) }}

nodes.notes: Only the total is used. The answer can hold one contact, so this workflow keeps no execution data (hard rule 4).

nodes.name: Write Google Sheet
nodes.notes: One row per week in the client's Sheet (row 1 = the column names, see README). Matches on Week, so a re-run updates the row instead of adding another.

nodes.name: Send Slack note
nodes.notes: Optional. Needs the 'FF Slack' credential and SLACK_CHANNEL in Config; a Slack failure never stops the workflow.
